findings.note: Gender drift across the locale, not a defect in these keys. Both new strings treat جاب as feminine ('جاب منسوخ نہیں ہو سکی۔', 'منسوخ نہیں ہوئی'), which is the natural Urdu treatment of the loan (it follows نوکری). Grep of every shipped ur value containing جاب finds exactly one agreement that fixes a gender: ui.chat.canonical.tool_row.verb.cancelled_job.settled 'جاب منسوخ کیا', where the perfective transitive agrees with its unmarked object and so reads جاب as masculine. All other hits are gender-neutral (کی/کا agree with جانچ/نتیجہ/منسوخی; 'جاب رک جائے'; 'منسوخ کر رہا' agrees with the implicit agent). The two new keys are internally consistent and idiomatic; the remedy belongs to the pre-existing tool row ('جاب منسوخ کی'), not here. Non-gating.
